name: Apprenticeship 9003828503 — POST with duplicate E&M LearnAimRef, then Approve
description: POSTs the ILR record for ULN 9003828503 (from NewApprenticeshipResponse_10038931.json), with original source dates and the provider changed to UKPRN 10005077, to the LearnerData Outer API. The englishAndMaths array holds two rows with the same LearnAimRef (6034992X): aim 3 (2024-08-12, paused/ended 2024-09-27) and aim 6 (2024-12-03, completed 2025-03-03). Costs are present on the on-programme aim. A second step then fires ApprenticeshipCreatedEvent to approve the learner as the employer. No assertions.
